correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<c<1 and 0<p<(3+sqrt(1-c))/4, the proof reconstructs deterministic innovation coefficients, establishes independently a sub-square-root bound by positive-renewal comparison, derives LLN by bounded-difference Azuma concentration, proves weighted finite-dimensional martingale CLTs with explicit Gram kernel, then supplies a new L^2 coefficient increment bound and Burkholder fourth moments for C([0,T]) tightness. Differentiation of the kernel is justified by the coefficient-growth exponent <1/2. The standalone finite checker passed 4,196 exact-rational assertions; asymptotic proof does not rely on enumeration. Hu--Xue Lemma 3.6 is an openly cited source premise.

value.rationale: The recently introduced proportional recent-memory random walk had only a one-time normal law. The entire diffusive trajectory has a non-Brownian Gaussian Volterra limit, with explicit two-time kernel, self-similarity and a sharp sign-sensitive memory diagnostic. This enables path functionals and distinguishes correlated diffusive scaling from Brownian motion. The new tightness estimate is a genuine structural step rather than parameter substitution.
